text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service=edge-proxy rev=v2.4.1-canary -> traffic=10% west-hemisphere @ 2026-02-14T18:35:01Z
incident-bot: Alert: region=us-west spike in 5xx for edge-proxy, current=12% (baseline 0.3%) — triggered at 18:38:10Z
mike (on-call): I'm looking. paging @anya @tzach. tagging SRE for immediate assist.
anya (eng): I see bursts of NXDOMAIN + some clients still resolving to old-green IPs. 502/503 cluster-side from green-backend for certain ASNs.
tzach (infra): Digging into authoritative NS. west-hemisphere authoritative has TTL=900 for new records, but a mirror region still serving an older zone with TTL=300. zone push may have partially failed -> some resolvers sticky to old answers.
support-ops: CS shows tickets about failed inference and higher latency from CA/WA customers, started ~18:37. severity=high for a handful of paying customers.
mike (on-call): Confirming customer impact. We need immediate mitigation: stop canary traffic and rollback canary deployment. Can someone flip the feature flag kill-switch?
anya (eng): I'm on FF. Running command to set flag to false now.
anya (eng): ```bash
# disable canary routing immediately
ffctl set edge_canary_enabled false --env prod --reason "urgent rollback: dns desync + 5xx spike"
# then undo deployment if flag flip insufficient
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=stable
```
deploy-bot: Received request: rollback edge-proxy -> initiating rollout undo (controller acked).
incident-bot: Action logged: feature-flag flip by anya at 18:40:03Z; rollout undo started at 18:40:10Z.
tzach (infra): DNS push in progress to remove stale zone on mirror. Patching glue entries and expiring caches where possible. Running tmctl to shift traffic weight to stable endpoints in control-plane as well.
leena (sre): Monitoring metrics. Alerts still firing but 5xx rate trending down (18:44 -> 4.2%). Not fully resolved due to cached DNS.
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty note: on-call escalation updated, minutes to acknowledge: 1, minutes to mitigation: 5.
mike (on-call): Good. Assigning follow-ups: @tzach - confirm authoritative zones are consistent and push completed; @anya - confirm the rollback completed and no canary pods receiving external traffic; @support-ops - compile customer impact list for CS and potential credits.
support-ops: Will pull impacted user list and sample request IDs. ETA 30m.
anya (eng): Rollback observed: pod template now at stable image, replica set scaled to stable target. No new canary pods recreated.
tzach (infra): DNS mirror push finished at 18:50:11Z. Verified SOA serial match across all authoritative servers. Forced DNS flush on our edge caches where supported.
leena (sre): Post-mit metrics: 5xx back to baseline 0.4% by 18:53. Latency normalized for most regions. A small fraction (~0.5%) of sessions still hitting old IPs due to external DNS cache TTL; expected to clear within TTL window.
mike (on-call): Customer impact summary for postmortem: small cohort in WA/CA experienced errors for ~15-20 minutes, some premium customers affected. No data loss. Action items: 1) postmortem, 2) improve DNS zone push validation, 3) add preflight to check authoritative NS TTL parity, 4) add automated kill-switch to traffic manager when 5xx > 5% for 5m.
anya (eng): I'll own the rollout-validation preflight and the kill-switch automation proof-of-concept.
tzach (infra): I'll add a step in the zone push job to fail the deploy when SOA mismatch detected and add retries for mirror propagation.
support-ops: I'll prepare CS messaging and impacted account list, attaching sample traces.
incident-bot: Incident marked: mitigated at 18:53:21Z. Please file a postmortem and link to this thread.
mike (on-call): Handoff to follow-up owners. I'm closing the live pager. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
